criteria.description: One full-height hero, one flexible video region, one video/source/poster/scrim/motion control, bottom band, h1, description, labeled email, submit, and legal link; zero nav/logo/second CTA
Top video region flexes to the remaining viewport height and meets the bottom band without gap or overlap
Band stacks narrowly and splits heading-left/support-right; form stacks narrow and becomes a row; no overflow at 320/390/767/768/1280
Pause/play exposes state; reduced motion starts paused on the poster; JS-off keeps a complete poster fallback
Visible label, native validation, corrective error, polite success, native no-JS action, and real terms destination
Visible focus, 44px targets, light/dark contrast, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
